title: Report context deficits instead of silent truncation
narrative: Mandatory blockers must not disappear when the prompt budget is tight. Success is a deficit report with unresolved gaps named. Related observation chain: `fangore_context_observation_chain`.
implementation:
`ContextCompiler` builds a versioned `ContextManifest` with token estimates and unresolved gaps. Working context is ephemeral; obligations stay in authoritative stores.

Covers: CTX-05.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/context_compiler_deficit.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
